meta.title: Mirsam — the PDF editor fluent in Arabic and English
meta.description: Mirsam (مرسام) is a free, open-source desktop PDF viewer and editor for macOS, Windows and Linux. Read, annotate, edit, fill, sign and redact PDFs, with first-class Arabic and on-device AI OCR. Your documents never leave your computer.
meta.ogAlt: Mirsam, the PDF editor fluent in Arabic and English

hero.eyebrow: Version {version} is out · free for macOS, Windows and Linux
hero.title: A PDF editor fluent in Arabic and English.
hero.lede: Mirsam is a fast desktop app for reading, annotating, editing, filling, signing and OCR-ing PDFs. Right-to-left text is never an afterthought, and your documents never leave your computer.
hero.meta: Free and open source (MIT) · No account · No telemetry
hero.logoLabel: The Mirsam logo: a pen nib writing on a page, with the name مرسام and Mirsam
hero.shotAlt: Mirsam with a bilingual contract open, page thumbnails in the side panel

features.title: One app, from first read to final signature.
features.lede: Mirsam covers the whole life of a document. Scroll through what version {version} can do.

chapters.title: Open anything. Scroll through a thousand pages without a stutter.
chapters.body: Pages appear at once and sharpen as you go. Find your way with thumbnails, the outline and tabs, and pick up exactly where you left off.
points: Smooth scrolling and pinch-zoom, even on huge files
Thumbnails, outline, tabs and recent files
Single page, two pages or book layout, left-to-right or right-to-left
Sepia and night reading themes, password-protected files, printing
chapters.alt: A two-column Arabic and English contract with page thumbnails beside it

chapters.title: Search that understands how Arabic is really typed.
chapters.body: Type without the hamza and still find it. Copy a mixed Arabic-English line and paste it in the right order, with numbers and names intact.
points: Finds الإيجار when you type الايجار
ة and ه, Arabic-Indic and Western digits match
Whole words, match case and regular expressions
Selection and copy in true reading order
chapters.alt: The search panel listing Arabic results, each highlighted on its page

chapters.title: Mark it up, talk it through.
chapters.body: Highlight, underline and strike out, add notes and text boxes, draw by hand, and follow every remark in the comments panel.
points: Highlights, underline, strike-through
Notes, text boxes and freehand drawing
A comments panel with replies
Move anything you place, to any page
chapters.alt: Highlights and notes on a page, with the comments panel open

chapters.title: Rearrange pages like cards on a table.
chapters.body: Drag pages into order, rotate or delete them, merge several files into one, or split one into many.
points: Reorder, rotate and delete pages
Merge files, split them, extract pages
Works the same in right-to-left documents
chapters.alt: The page organizer showing a grid of pages

chapters.title: Change the words on the page. Yes, in Arabic too.
chapters.body: Click a paragraph and edit it in place, with the original font, shaping and direction kept. Add your own text, images and links.
points: Edit the page's own text in place, Arabic and English
Add text, images and links
Headers, footers, page numbers and watermarks
Find and replace across the document
chapters.alt: An Arabic paragraph being edited in place on the page

chapters.title: Fill it, sign it, send it.
chapters.body: Fill in any form, or put text and a signature anywhere with Fill & Sign. Create fillable forms of your own, and sign with a certificate when it has to be official.
points: Fill and create forms, with Arabic that shapes correctly
Fill & Sign with drawn or typed signatures
Certificate signatures (PAdES), checked when you open a file
chapters.alt: Fill & Sign: a typed signature placed on a form

chapters.title: When it's gone, it's really gone.
chapters.body: Redaction removes the text and images underneath, not just covers them. Find what to hide by pattern, then lock the file with a password.
points: True redaction of text, images and patterns
Passwords and permissions
Remove hidden data before sharing
chapters.alt: Redaction marks over personal data on a page

chapters.title: Take your pages anywhere.
chapters.body: Export pages as images, or the text as plain text or Markdown, in correct reading order. Make big files small enough to email.
points: Export pages as images
Export text or Markdown
Compress files
chapters.alt: The export dialog with its format choices

arabic.title: Built right to left from day one.
arabic.lede: Most PDF tools treat Arabic as an edge case. In Mirsam every feature, from search to editing to OCR, works in Arabic and in mixed Arabic-English documents in its very first version.
arabic.selectBody: Select across a line that mixes Arabic, English and numbers. What you paste reads exactly like the page.
arabic.selectLine: اشتريت 3 أجهزة iPhone 15 Pro من المتجر.
arabic.searchBody: Hamza or no hamza, ة or ه, ٢٠٢٦ or 2026: Mirsam finds what you meant.
arabic.digitsBody: Arabic-Indic and Western numerals are the same number to search, and the Arabic interface writes its own numbers in Arabic-Indic digits.
arabic.compareTitle: Switch the whole app to Arabic
arabic.compareBody: The entire interface mirrors, from the toolbar to the page order. Drag to compare.
arabic.compareLabel: Compare the English and Arabic interface
arabic.compareAltAr: Mirsam's interface in Arabic, laid out right to left

ocr.title: Turn scans into text with an AI model that lives on your laptop.
ocr.lede: Mirsam reads scanned Arabic and English pages with a vision AI model that runs entirely on your computer. Scans become searchable, copyable and even editable, and not a single page is uploaded anywhere.
ocr.demoLabel: A scanned page being read by Mirsam's OCR

steps.title: Instant draft
steps.body: Your system's own OCR (Apple Vision on Mac, Tesseract elsewhere) gives you searchable text within seconds.

steps.title: AI reads the page
steps.body: Nuqta, an AI model trained for Arabic documents, reads every page again, carefully, on your computer.

steps.title: Second opinion
steps.body: A smaller model re-reads uncertain lines and every number, date and ID, so amounts and names come out right.

steps.title: You stay in control
steps.body: Words the readers disagree on are flagged for you to review. The AI never invents a name or a number.

ocr.secureTitle: Your documents never leave your laptop.
ocr.secureBody: Cloud OCR services ask you to upload your contracts, IDs and bank statements to someone else's servers. Mirsam's AI runs locally, so there is nothing to upload and nobody to trust but your own computer.

securePoints.title: Runs offline
securePoints.body: After a one-time, optional model download, OCR works with the internet switched off.

securePoints.title: Nothing is sent
securePoints.body: No page, word or file name leaves your computer. The download itself sends nothing about you or your documents.

securePoints.title: No account, no cloud
securePoints.body: No sign-up, no API keys, no usage limits, no per-page fees.

securePoints.title: Open for inspection
securePoints.body: Mirsam is open source, so anyone can check exactly what it does.

ocr.diagramLabel: Diagram: the document and the AI model both stay inside your computer; the connection to the cloud is cut.

ocr.accuracyNote: Built for accuracy over speed: the best model takes its time, and you can keep working while it reads in the background.
ocr.shotAlt: Mirsam's OCR review mode, with uncertain words marked on a scanned page

privacy.body: Mirsam connects to the internet only when you ask it to: to download OCR models, to add a trusted time-stamp to a signature, or to open a link.

download.title: Get Mirsam {version}.
download.lede: Free and open source, for macOS, Windows and Linux. The links always fetch the latest release.

platforms.name: macOS
platforms.requirements: macOS 13 or later · Apple silicon or Intel
platforms.install: Open the disk image and drag Mirsam to Applications.

platforms.name: Windows
platforms.install: Run the setup program. If Windows shows “Windows protected your PC”, choose More info, then Run anyway.

platforms.name: Linux
platforms.install: Install the package with your software installer, or make the AppImage executable and run it.

download.ocrNote: OCR models are an optional download from inside the app, so the installers stay small.
